programs.title: Asian Times
programs.desc: Julian Hanton visits Asia.It checks what changes are taking place on the continent, where economic recovery goes hand in hand with population growth.The leader begins his journey in Hong Kong, where he inadvertently agrees to take a punch from Bruce Lee.This experience will be remembered for a long time.In Thailand, he makes friends with investigative journalists, becomes a secret agent and monitors local gambling.In the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia and China, he carefully observes people and their behavior.He discovers that all corners of the world are an inexhaustible source of knowledge.

programs.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programs.desc: Boston is a city of great historical and scientific importance.This is where prestigious universities such as Harvard and MIT are located, as well as the headquarters of Boston Dynamics, known for creating humanoid robots.Although the city is associated with the American Revolution, it also has lesser-known stories.Marcin will meet a guide who will talk about the first settlers and explain events such as the flooding of the city by molasses in the early 20th century, the smell of which can still be felt on hot days.Marcin will also talk to Walter Robinson from the Boston Globe about the famous journalistic investigation presented in the film "Spotlight", which revealed a scandal in the local archdiocese, affecting the city and the world.In addition, the host will take viewers to Salem, a town known for its witch trials from three hundred years ago.Today, the Salem witches attract tourists and are one of the area's main attractions.

programs.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programs.desc: Country music is a key part of American culture.Thanks to contemporary artists such as Taylor Swift and Beyonce, the genre is attracting new generations of listeners.During his visit to Nashville, Marcin Prokop tries to understand what makes country more than just music.He meets with the artists' agent, visits an independent music studio where he observes a recording session, and talks to the curator of the legendary Ryman Auditorium.He also discovers a unique Polish exhibit in a private automotive museum.During his journey, he meets Tomek Wosiak, an emigrant from Gdynia, a renowned chef and manager of popular restaurants in the USA, who cooperates with the biggest stars.

programs.title: Alaska Gold Diggers
programs.desc: Extraordinary encounters with Sarah-Jane and her four daughters who have teamed up to restart two gold mines in Alaska.Cameras closely follow their daily struggles.

programs.title: Marooned with Ed Stafford 2
programs.desc: Former British Army captain and experienced traveler Ed Stafford continues to overcome new challenges.He became known to viewers as a steadfast man who is able to cope with any extreme situation.So far, among others:he underwent a test of survival for 60 days on one of the uninhabited islands of Fiji, where he had no supplies of food, clothing or necessary equipment.Moreover, he walked the trail leading along the Amazon River, which earned him a place in history and the Guinness Book of Records.In the next series of the program "Ed Stafford Beyond Civilization", the traveler once again sets off to the most hostile corners of the world, including the Gobi Desert in Mongolia and the crocodile-infested Guatemalan jungle.

programs.title: Ed Stafford: First Man Out
programs.desc: British survival school champion, Ed Stafford, competes with other veterans in this art.Participants will try to get out of the most hostile areas of Asia.

programs.title: Naked and Afraid 7
programs.desc: Two unknown people, a woman and a man, are left in a lonely place with difficult climatic conditions.They must spend 21 days there without food, water or clothing.They can only take one item with them.Operators show how people relying on their own company learn to cooperate and make key decisions together.Viewers will see that appropriate knowledge and skills can be very useful in extreme moments and even determine survival.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska reaches La Paz.Bolivian women have played a primarily reproductive role for centuries.They are caregivers in their families, dependent on men in every aspect of life.If they do not want to comply, they may be beaten.It is in Bolivia that the rate of violence against women remains the highest in all of South America.Meanwhile, some of them decided to fight stereotypes and exchange chef's aprons for crayfish and then conquer the peaks.Martyna Wojciechowska meets such people.They belong to the cholit climbing team from La Paz, led by its founder, Alicia.In this episode, the traveler will also visit Carmen Rojas, the heroine of the first season of the program.
